libs.note: BH-5791. The caller check after the build's main merge: the `caller check` block in bin/lib/rb/pr.sh runs bin/caller-check.sh after the rebase verify and puts `## Interface callers (BH-5791)` into the PR body. Read per project through lib_env_apply caller-check <project> in cc_conf. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-10-BH-5791-design-collisions.md.

knobs.note: How many caller bullets the PR body section prints; the rest are counted and stay in callers.txt on the build box. 0 = the caller check is off: it does not run and the PR body carries no section. A value that is not a whole number uses 60.
